title: Defense Secretary Hegseth requires new 'pledge' for reporters at the Pentagon
summary: The Pentagon is implementing new guidelines that will require journalists to sign a pledge and agree to report only approved and officially released information.

title: Jimmy Kimmel's suspension shows power of FCC's Brendan Carr
summary: In the eight months since becoming chair of the Federal Communications Commission, Brendan Carr has waged war against the free speech of those who have reported on, criticized, or satirized the president.
